title: ECP Protected Ground Truth (FORMAT ONLY)
$comment: PROTECTED BOUNDARY. This schema describes the structure of sealed ground-truth documents so that public commitments can be computed and verified. Real ground-truth values (content_class 'sealed') are NEVER committed to the public repository - they live in a protected store outside the public trust boundary. Only content_class 'format-illustration' documents (public dummy values) may appear publicly, and only under examples/. The boundary scanner and the test suite enforce this.

content_class.description: 'sealed' = real protected ground truth (must live OUTSIDE the public repository). 'format-illustration' = public dummy values demonstrating the format (examples/ only).

value.description: The expected answer value (any JSON value) - PROTECTED CONTENT when content_class is 'sealed'.

derivation.$comment: Ordered derivation steps establishing the expected answer - PROTECTED CONTENT when content_class is 'sealed'. Authored-case policy recommends at least 2 inference steps.

spec.description: Full rule semantics - PROTECTED CONTENT when content_class is 'sealed' (the public case carries only rule_id/rule_type).

protocol_version.description: Protocol version the ground truth was sealed under; the commitment covers this field, so a re-seal under a new protocol version is a new commitment.
